text.tspan: 1 Peter and the OT: Quotations, Citations, Allusions, and Influence
Note: 4:8 and Proverbs 10:12 is marked with a “?” due to Jobes’ comment that this is probably not a quotation but rather Pete
utilizing a “proverbial use” of the proverb “that was in circulation” at that time (Jobes, 2023, p. 597).
